segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Good morning everyone, let's get started. Agenda for today is the website launch date, the payment gateway, and the vendor budget.

segments.speaker: Rahul
segments.text: Haan, website ka design almost ready hai. Bas mobile view mein thoda kaam baaki hai, I think one more week lagega.

segments.speaker: Anita
segments.text: If design needs one more week, can we still launch on the 15th?

segments.speaker: Rahul
segments.text: पंद्रह तारीख थोड़ा मुश्किल है। अगर हम बीस तारीख रखें तो testing के लिए भी समय मिल जाएगा।

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Theek hai, let's finalize the 20th as the launch date. Sab agree karte hain?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Next, payment gateway. Vikram, any update?

segments.speaker: Vikram
segments.text: Maine Razorpay aur PayU dono se baat ki. Razorpay ka fee 2 percent hai, PayU ka 1.9 percent, but Razorpay ka integration hamare developer ko pehle se aata hai.

segments.speaker: Anita
segments.text: The difference is small. I would prefer Razorpay because it will save development time.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: ठीक है, Razorpay फाइनल करते हैं। विक्रम, तुम शुक्रवार तक उनसे agreement sign करवा लो।

segments.speaker: Vikram
segments.text: Sure, I will get it signed by Friday.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Last item, vendor budget. The quote we got is 3.5 lakh rupees.

segments.speaker: Anita
segments.text: Yeh thoda zyada lag raha hai. Kya hum ek aur quote le sakte hain before deciding?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Good point. Anita, tum next week tak do aur quotes le aao, phir hum decide karenge.

segments.speaker: Rahul
segments.text: Also, who is writing the content for the About Us page? Nobody has picked it up yet.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Achha, us par next meeting mein baat karte hain. Thank you everyone, meeting khatam karte hain.
